art_direction: 几枚弯曲琴键悬成小桥，清水从末端落入陶碗，木纹与水流细节紧凑集中。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: A short sequence of piano keys bends upward into a small bridge, and clear water flows across the keys before falling into a shallow ceramic bowl below. Show only this detached fragment of an imaginary instrument, not a full piano. The keys are aged ivory and charcoal, their base dark polished wood; the bowl is matte celadon. Use a deep aubergine background to separate the pale keys and thin water stream. Render the worn key edges, subtle wood grain, a few suspended droplets, and concentric ripples in the bowl. Keep the whole arrangement compact and centered, with the water forming one readable connecting line. No musical notation, lettering, or extra objects.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
